teks.Struktur prediksi AlphaFold untuk protei: AlphaFold predicted structures for proteins without a crystal structure. Type a UniProt accession (e.g. P00918) or a protein/gene name (e.g. ACE2), then Search.
teks.Ujung N/C yang tak beraturan (pLDDT rend: Disordered N/C termini (low pLDDT) can cover the pocket and disturb pocket detection. The protein is colored by pLDDT: dark blue > 90, light blue 70–90, yellow 50–70, orange < 50. Data license CC BY 4.0 — cite Jumper et al. 2021 and Varadi et al. 2024.
teks.AlphaFold: model prediksi tanpa ligan/ko: AlphaFold: predicted model without ligands/cofactors/ions — pocket side chains may differ from the bound form. Check pLDDT in the pocket, consider validation with a reference ligand, and cite the model source in your methods.
